@NativeType("struct FTC_SBitRec") public class FTC_SBit extends Struct<FTC_SBit>
struct FTC_SBitRec {
    FT_Byte width;
    FT_Byte height;
    FT_Char left;
    FT_Char top;
    FT_Byte format;
    FT_Byte max_grays;
    FT_Short pitch;
    FT_Char xadvance;
    FT_Char yadvance;
    FT_Byte * buffer;
}

  • Constructor Details

    • FTC_SBit

      public FTC_SBit(ByteBuffer container)
      Creates a FTC_SBit instance at the current position of the specified ByteBuffer container. Changes to the buffer's content will be visible to the struct instance and vice versa.

      The created instance holds a strong reference to the container object.
